text_simplified: The successful father and the guided mother are keen to raise their daughters with an Islamic upbringing that absolves their responsibility, for daughters are the cores of the heart, and brief counsels have been gathered for father and mother. The author then mentions the virtue of ihsan toward them: the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever cares for two girls until they reach maturity will come on the Day of Resurrection—he and I," and he ﷺ said: "Whoever is tested with anything regarding these daughters, they will be a shield for him from the Fire." Ibn Hajar and Imam al-Nawawi explained the meaning of the test, and that the Sharia warned against disliking daughters.
